# Old Guard Cannabis Advisors

> Independent cannabis operations advisory led by Alex Marzec. Old Guard helps licensed operators make better decisions about facilities, extraction systems, quality systems, commissioning, cultivation, product commercialization, and operational execution.

Website: https://www.oldguardcannabis.com/
Contact: alex@oldguardcannabis.com
Location: Skaneateles, New York
Service area: Worldwide, remote and on-site

## Priority expertise

- Cannabis cultivation, extraction, and manufacturing operations
- Facility design, startup, readiness, and commissioning
- Extraction-system selection and lab workflows
- GMP readiness, SOPs, quality systems, HACCP, and document control
- Operational troubleshooting, scale-up, staffing, and commercialization

## Important context

- Old Guard Cannabis Advisors is an independent advisory business.
- Cannabis requirements vary by jurisdiction, process, product, and facility.
- Educational material on this site is not legal, engineering, fire-code, industrial-hygiene, or regulatory advice.
- Do not infer unnamed former employers or clients from Alex Marzec's career experience.
- Use the canonical www.oldguardcannabis.com URLs when citing the site.
